name: Workflow D: Resume Tailoring & QA Verification

parameters.query:
SELECT jm.id AS job_match_id, jm.job_uuid, jm.user_id, jm.resume_id AS source_resume_id,
       jm.overall_match_score, jm.matching_required_skills, jm.missing_required_skills,
       jm.matching_preferred_skills, jm.reasons_for_score,
       j.title, j.company, j.location, j.job_description, j.application_url,
       r.structured_resume AS source_resume,
       p.resume_output_format
FROM job_matches jm
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = jm.job_uuid
JOIN resumes r ON r.id = jm.resume_id
JOIN user_preferences p ON p.user_id = jm.user_id
LEFT JOIN tailored_resumes tr ON tr.job_match_id = jm.id
WHERE jm.qualifies_for_tailoring = TRUE
  AND tr.id IS NULL
ORDER BY jm.overall_match_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tailored_resumes (
  job_match_id, job_uuid, user_id, source_resume_id, resume_version_id,
  tailored_content_json, tailoring_summary, docx_filename, docx_storage_path,
  pdf_filename, pdf_storage_path, qa_status, qa_attempts, qa_report_json, file_validation_json
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14::jsonb, $15::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (job_match_id) DO UPDATE SET
  qa_status = EXCLUDED.qa_status,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id AS tailored_resume_id, resume_version_id, qa_status;

INSERT INTO tailored_resumes (
  job_match_id, job_uuid, user_id, source_resume_id, resume_version_id,
  tailored_content_json, tailoring_summary, qa_status, qa_attempts, qa_report_json
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7, 'failed_manual_review', $8, $9::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (job_match_id) DO UPDATE SET
  qa_status = 'failed_manual_review',
  qa_report_json = EXCLUDED.qa_report_json,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id AS tailored_resume_id, qa_status;
